Speaker: Forge
Text: The furnaces here have been running wild since the Rift. No one to tend them. No one brave enough to try.

Speaker: Forge
Text: A blacksmith doesn't abandon his forge. Even when the forge tries to kill him. It's a matter of honor.

Speaker: Forge
Text: You're heading deeper, aren't you? I've seen something down there. A guardian — made of living metal and fire.

Speaker: Forge
Text: You'll need good steel at your side. I'm coming with you.
